<required_reading>

Read `${SKILL_DIR}/references/standing-rules.md`.

</required_reading>

<process>

1. Lead with evidence, consequence, options, and one recommendation.
2. Classify the decision through the standing autonomous and operator-held
   classes.
3. For an autonomous class, record one `decision` ledger event containing the
   class, choice, and reasoning.
4. Hold only the affected decision and continue every independent officer.

</process>

<success_criteria>

The result names the decision class and disposition; an autonomous disposition
includes a derivable reasoning event, while a held disposition pauses only its
dependent action.

</success_criteria>
